nuggets.text: When the Colts left Baltimore on March 29, 1984, Mayflower moving trucks hauled the team's belongings to Indianapolis.
The Colts got their name from Baltimore's long history of horse breeding and racing.
The Colts have hosted the NFL Scouting Combine in Indianapolis every year since 1987.
The Colts' Lucas Oil Stadium has a retractable roof that opens or closes in about 11 minutes.
Colts receiver Keenan Allen competed on The Masked Singer in 2023 as 'Gargoyle.'
Keenan Allen, who joined the Colts in August, reached 1,000 catches in 159 games, the fastest in NFL history.
Sauce Gardner was the first rookie cornerback since Ronnie Lott in 1981 to be named first-team All-Pro.
In Berlin last season, Jonathan Taylor ran for 244 yards and broke Edgerrin James' Colts record for career rushing touchdowns.
Colts coach Shane Steichen was a four-year quarterback at UNLV, and his older brother Sean punted at Boise State.
The Colts lead the all-time series with the Ravens 11-7 and won the last meeting, 22-19 in overtime, in 2023.
